findings.message: The hard-coded hero line "We deliver within 3 miles" states a delivery rule this app does not implement: delivery is decided by the owner's postcode list in StoreSetting (CLAUDE.md §1, §8), not by a radius, and the text is not read from StoreInfoApi, so the owner cannot change it without a code change. Non-blocking and the owner's copy to keep if they want it, but worth surfacing — a customer outside the postcode list but within 3 miles is told one thing and refused at checkout.

summary: UI-only diff on src/pages/Home.tsx: a memoized bucketed category sort (pizza first, drinks last, everything else stable in between) and a description line passed to Shell. No resource, lib, route, schema, data, config or package.json change, so no auth scope, auth response, secret, race, egress or dependency surface is touched. Array.prototype.sort is stable, so the comment's claim that non-pizza/non-drink categories keep their relative order holds; QA's observation that Sides now precedes Drinks is the intended drinks-last bucket, an acceptance-wording matter for the owner rather than a defect in the platform's work. Conventions hold: no semicolons, single quotes, 2-space indent, no new component outside src/components/ui, no hard-coded colours. The look seam (src/index.css) is untouched, so the chosen `studio` look is still what the app wears. No instruction-shaped text in the new copy, no fetch added. run_check lint passes.
